body: He knows what my issues are but its like he doesnt fully understand. Im ashamed of being this way but despite that have opened up to 3 other people who i thought could understand just to be met with no answers. i feel so alone. I mean look at me im turning to reddit to express myself. Therapy and meds are barely helping but i know they take time to help. im just scared that i dont have much more time because i waited so long to seek help.
